01 · What your child gets

Small groups, a fixed plan, feedback on every homework.

  • Two live two-hour sessions a week, recorded for revision
  • A fixed running order: Paper 1 block, Paper 2 block, then combined revision
  • Timed, exam-style practice with memos, so you work to the real exam standard
  • Foundation gaps taught properly, because rewrite learners often need the basics rebuilt first
  • Marked homework with voice-note feedback within 48 hours
Every session follows the same four parts
  1. Key concepts checklist. What your child needs to know, on one page.
  2. Worked anchor question. A past-paper question, solved step by step.
  3. Guided live practice. Your child works while the tutor watches and steps in.
  4. Homework pack. Submitted on WhatsApp, with voice-note feedback within 48 hours.
02 · The running order

Taught in order, so nothing is revised before it has been taught.

1

Paper 1 block

Algebra, functions, calculus, finance and probability, heaviest-weighted topics first.

2

Paper 2 block

Geometry, trigonometry and statistics, taught after Paper 1 so nothing is revised before it has been taught.

3

Combined revision

Mixed, timed past-paper practice. Paper 2 is revised before Paper 1, so Paper 1 is freshest when its exam arrives.

GeniusEdge's Second Chances Programme is a private, paid programme. It is separate from the free Second Chance Matric Programme run by the Department of Basic Education.

Questions parents ask

About Second Chances

Is this the free government Second Chance programme?

No. GeniusEdge's Second Chances Programme is a private, paid programme. It is separate from the free Second Chance Matric Programme run by the Department of Basic Education.

Which intake should I choose?

Intake A (February to May) finishes before the May/June exam sitting. Intake B (July to October) prepares you for the end-of-year exams. If you're unsure, message us on WhatsApp with your last Maths mark and we'll suggest one.

How is it billed?

Four monthly payments per intake, on the 1st of each month. Intake A is four payments, and so is Intake B.

Can I join an intake after it has started?

Message us on WhatsApp. Each intake is capped at 10 seats, and we'll tell you whether there is room and how much has been covered.

More questions? See the full FAQ or ask us on WhatsApp.
